why: A February 2025 arXiv preprint (Li, Xiao, Zuo) verifies the Nakai conjecture for isolated hypersurface singularities of modality ≤ 2, a new case settled within the conjecture's own scope; the Wikipedia article confirms the conjecture remains open in general otherwise.
